objective: Recover at least nine additional identity-clean strict ABCB1 non-substrate candidates from official regulatory reports or source-traceable primary studies, without changing the frozen model or threshold.
predeclared_search_concepts: not a substrate of P-gp plus MDR1-MDCK or LLC-PK1
net efflux ratio below 2 plus matched parent or wild-type
no difference between P-gp-expressing and non-expressing cells
efflux ratio unchanged by selective P-gp inhibitor plus valid positive control
strict_negative_rule: Admit only a released parent drug or named metabolite tested in human ABCB1-transfected cells with matched non-expressing, wild-type, mock, or knockout-background cells, where net ER is below 2 or transporter and parent values show no selective differential. A same-batch positive control or selective-inhibitor condition must demonstrate assay competence when exposed.
allowed_exception: A matched-parent multi-concentration study with net ER below 2 and a documented same-batch positive control may be admitted without a substrate-assay inhibitor condition.
secondary_only: Transfectant-only ER, qualitative regulatory call, Caco-2-only data, non-human transporter, raw ER without background correction, unspecified metabolite mixture, or missing structure remains outside the formal metric.
identity_rule: Exclude exact InChIKey or connectivity-block overlap with the frozen 443 training set, development sets, prior stress sets, and regulatory candidate ledger v3.
source_lineage_rule: Retain sponsor study identifiers, report numbers, cited publications, assay vendor, shared positive controls, and common upstream experiments; report count is not treated as proof of laboratory independence.
stopping_rule: Stop formal-negative collection when the frozen strict pool contains at least 15 negatives, then run a final identity and source-lineage audit before any model scoring.
modeling_rule: No scoring, refit, calibration, threshold tuning, feature selection, applicability-domain modification, or post-result candidate removal during batch4 collection.
